data.content_ref: inline:Accrual as collective defeat via collector nodes: for a bounded set of weak attacks {A_i→B} that should defeat B only together, add a collector node C, add edges from every attacker of each A_i to C, and add C→B; replace the individual weak attacks with the single collective attack. In the grounded extension C is accepted exactly when every A_i is accepted, so B is out only under joint accrual. The construction is linear in the sum of attacker sets and the fixpoint remains polynomial. Criticizable: the encoding assumes attacks on the A_i are independent and may create unintended defense paths through C; overlapping accrual sets can blow up unless bounded.
